simple.prompt: It-cleft to focus on the person: '___ who initiated the green energy campaign.'
simple.explanation: Struktur It-cleft untuk memberi penekanan pada pelaku: It + is/was + fokus subjek + who/that...

simple.prompt: Wh-cleft / Pseudo-cleft with 'What': '___ is a comprehensive review of our cybersecurity protocols.'
simple.explanation: Wh-cleft: What-clause + is/was + fokus ('What we urgently require is...').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat It-cleft untuk penekanan waktu.
simple.targetSentence: It was in 2015 that the company was founded.
simple.explanation: It was + in 2015 (fokus waktu) + that the company was founded.
hints: Klausa penjelas: 'that the company was founded'.

simple.prompt: Focusing on an action with 'What... did': 'What the CEO ___ apologize directly to affected consumers.'
simple.explanation: Wh-cleft untuk aksi masa lalu: What + subjek + did + was + base verb / to-infinitive.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Wh-cleft dengan 'What surprised me'.
simple.targetSentence: What surprised me most was his complete indifference.
simple.explanation: What surprised me most (wh-clause) + was + his complete indifference (focus).

simple.prompt: Focusing on a place: 'It was in Zurich ___ the international accord was signed.'
simple.explanation: Dalam It-cleft, kata sambung baku yang paling netral dan umum adalah 'that' (atau where dalam ragam santai). Dalam tulisan formal, 'that' sangat dianjurkan.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat It-cleft untuk penekanan objek.
simple.targetSentence: It was the marketing budget that they decided to reduce.
simple.explanation: It was the marketing budget + that they decided to reduce.
hints: Mulai dengan 'It was the marketing budget'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'that they decided to reduce'.

simple.prompt: It was Dr. Maya ___ first spotted the calibration error in the thermal camera.
simple.explanation: It-cleft yang menonjolkan pelaku manusia ('Dr. Maya') menggunakan 'who' atau 'that'.
hints: Kata benda yang ditekankan adalah seorang tokoh ('Dr. Maya').

simple.prompt: ___ our remote support team needs most right now is a unified ticket dashboard.
simple.explanation: Wh-cleft clause di awal kalimat bermakna 'Hal yang paling dibutuhkan...' selalu diawali 'What'.

simple.prompt: It wasn't until Friday evening ___ the customs agency cleared the medical shipment.
simple.explanation: It-cleft penekanan waktu/kondisi memakai pola tetap 'It was/wasn't until ... THAT ...' (bukan 'when').
hints: Pola It-cleft selalu memakai penghubung 'that' di klausa kedua.

simple.prompt: It was the outdated firmware, rather than weak Wi-Fi, ___ caused those sudden disconnections.
simple.explanation: Untuk menekankan objek benda atau sebab ('the outdated firmware') dalam It-cleft, gunakan 'that' (atau 'which').
hints: Benda yang disorot adalah 'the outdated firmware'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog koreksi lokasi dengan It-cleft penekanan tempat.
dialogue: Visitor
Didn't the maritime exhibition open in Hall A last month?
Curator
Actually, it was in Hall C ___ we installed the historic ship models.
simple.explanation: Karena frasa berpreposisi ('in Hall C') sudah lengkap, penghubung baku It-cleft tetap 'that' (bukan 'where').
hints: Perhatikan sudah ada preposisi 'in' sebelum 'Hall C'.

simple.prompt: What makes this lightweight tablet stand out ___ its twelve-hour battery life.
simple.explanation: Wh-cleft clause ('What makes...') dianggap subjek tunggal sehingga memakai to be 'is' sebelum pelengkap tunggal.
hints: Pelengkap yang disorot tunggal ('its twelve-hour battery life').

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penghubung 'when' pada kalimat It-cleft waktu berikut.
simple.draft: It was only last September when the downtown tramway opened to daily commuters.
options: It was only last September that the downtown tramway opened to daily commuters.
It was only last September which the downtown tramway opened to daily commuters.
It was only last September what the downtown tramway opened to daily commuters.
simple.explanation: Dalam It-cleft penekanan waktu ('It was + time...'), bahasa Inggris baku memakai 'that', bukan 'when' atau 'which'.
hints: Pola baku It-cleft adalah 'It + be + [fokus] + that...'.

simple.prompt: It is only the quarterly tax summary ___ you need to sign before leaving.
simple.explanation: Untuk menekankan objek dokumen ('the quarterly tax summary') dalam It-cleft, gunakan 'that'.

simple.targetSentence: It was the night engineer who noticed the hairline crack first.
simple.explanation: It + was + pelaku + who + verb + pelengkap.
hints: Awali dengan 'It was the night engineer'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Wh-cleft untuk menekankan kebutuhan tim.
simple.targetSentence: What the hospital urgently requires is an additional backup generator.
simple.explanation: Wh-cleft clause tunggal 'What the hospital urgently requires' + is + noun phrase.
hints: Mulai dengan 'What the hospital urgently requires is'.

dialogue: Client
Did the sales associate provide the inaccurate tariff data?
Manager
No, ___ who miscalculated the export duties.
options: it was the automated billing software
there was the automated billing software
intermediate.explanation: It-cleft digunakan untuk mengoreksi kesalahpahaman secara tegas dan jelas: 'No, it was [X] that/who...'.
hints: Gunakan 'it was the automated billing software'.

intermediate.prompt: All-cleft for exclusive emphasis: '___ was ask for a twenty-four-hour extension on the project.'
intermediate.explanation: All-cleft: All + subject + verb + was/is + (to) infinitive ('All I did was ask...').
hints: Hanya hal itu yang saya lakukan.

intermediate.prompt: Reversed Wh-cleft: 'A lack of proper communication ___ to the team's downfall.'
intermediate.explanation: Reversed wh-cleft: Focus noun phrase + is/was + what-clause ('A lack of communication was what led...').
hints: Fokus di depan dibalas dengan 'was what...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: All she wanted was a fair chance to present her findings.
intermediate.explanation: All she wanted + was + a fair chance to present her findings.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'a fair chance to present her findings'.

intermediate.prompt: Person-cleft with 'The person who': '___ designed the award-winning library was a local architect.'
intermediate.explanation: The person who / The one who cleft: 'The person who designed... was...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: Her unwavering resilience is what inspired the whole department.
intermediate.explanation: Her unwavering resilience + is what inspired + the whole department.
hints: Mulai dengan subjek fokus 'Her unwavering resilience'.
Cleft klausa: 'is what inspired the whole department'.

dialogue: Founder
Should we expand our warehouse capacity immediately?
CFO
No, ___ is stabilize our cash flow reserves.
intermediate.explanation: What we must do first is + base verb ('stabilize').

intermediate.prompt: To emphasize an ACTION with a Wh-cleft: 'What the technician did next ___ calibrate every acoustic sensor individually.'
intermediate.explanation: Pada Wh-cleft penekanan tindakan ('What + S + did + be + (to) V1'), penghubung utama selalu bentuk 'to be' ('was'), BUKAN 'did'.
hints: Klausa 'What the technician did next' membutuhkan linking verb to be 'was'.
Setelah 'was', verb dasar 'calibrate' dapat muncul langsung.

intermediate.prompt: ___ the research grant really asks for is measurable community impact rather than abstract theory.
intermediate.explanation: 'All (that) + S + verb + is...' adalah all-cleft yang menyoroti satu hal esensial ('satu-satunya yang diminta').

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan penegasan ulang memakai Reversed Wh-cleft.
dialogue: Manager
Wait — is budget expansion our main bottleneck?
Director
No, clearer cross-team communication ___ what we truly lack.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam Reversed Wh-cleft ('X is what we truly lack'), frasa yang ditekankan ('clearer cross-team communication') diletakkan di awal sebagai subjek tunggal sebelum 'is what...'.

intermediate.prompt: The person ___ deserves credit for automating the payroll script is definitely Riko.
intermediate.explanation: Cleft bertema manusia ('The person who... is...') memakai relative pronoun subjek 'who' sebelum verb 'deserves'.

intermediate.prompt: All the audit committee requested ___ two extra days to verify receipts.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa 'All the audit committee requested' berfungsi sebagai subjek tunggal masa lampau bagi verb 'was'.
hints: Kata kerja di dalam klausa adalah lampau ('requested').
Subjek klausa 'All...' memakai to be tunggal lampau 'was'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan agreement to be pada It-cleft subjek jamak berikut.
intermediate.draft: It were the regional coordinators who raised the packaging defect first.
options: It was the regional coordinators who raised the packaging defect first.
It are the regional coordinators who raised the packaging defect first.
It were the regional coordinators which raised the packaging defect first.
intermediate.explanation: ATURAN MUTLAK IT-CLEFT: Kata 'It' di awal selalu berpasangan dengan to be TUNGGAL ('It is / It was'), BUKAN 'It were', meskipun fokus setelahnya berbentuk jamak ('the regional coordinators')!
hints: Subjek gramatikal di depan adalah kata tunggal 'It'.

intermediate.prompt: It is because the harbor bridge is under repair ___ ferry traffic has doubled this week.
intermediate.explanation: Pada It-cleft penekanan klausa sebab ('It is because... THAT...'), penghubungnya tetap 'that' (jangan mengulang 'why' atau 'because').

intermediate.prompt: The reason ___ our dispatch team switched couriers was reliability during monsoon storms.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam reason-cleft formal, gunakan pola 'The reason (why)... was + noun phrase / that...' — JANGAN menulis 'The reason why... was because...'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Wh-cleft penekanan tindakan dengan 'What + S + did + was'.
intermediate.targetSentence: What our designer did first was sketch three minimalist homepage layouts.
intermediate.explanation: Struktur 'What + S + did + was + V1' menonjolkan aksi pertama yang dilakukan.
hints: Awali dengan 'What our designer did first was'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Reversed Wh-cleft dengan tepat.
intermediate.targetSentence: Consistent daily practice is what builds long-term speaking fluency.
intermediate.explanation: Hal yang ditekankan diletakkan di awal ('Consistent daily practice'), diikuti 'is what builds...'.
hints: Lengkapi dengan 'what builds long-term speaking fluency'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi agreement pada It-cleft dengan pronoun orang pertama.
complex.draft: It is I who is responsible for the organizational oversight.
options: It is I who am responsible for the organizational oversight.
It is me who are responsible for the organizational oversight.
It is I whom is responsible for the organizational oversight.
complex.explanation: Dalam standar preskriptif bahasa Inggris formal, kata kerja di dalam klausa penjelas menyesuaikan dengan subjek pronoun 'I': 'It is I who AM responsible' (bukan who is).
hints: Gunakan 'It is I who am responsible'.

complex.prompt: Rhetorical function of cleft sentences in expository prose:
options: To strategically redistribute information by creating a clear boundary between 'given' information and 'new' focal points.
To avoid using passive voice at all costs.
complex.explanation: Cleft sentences membelah satu klausa menjadi dua bagian (cleft) untuk mengarahkan atensi pembaca tepat pada informasi baru/kunci (information packaging).

complex.prompt: The reason why-cleft: '___ resigned so abruptly remains shrouded in mystery.'
complex.explanation: Cleft penjelas alasan: 'The reason why she resigned...'.
hints: Menyoroti alasan di balik suatu peristiwa.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat It-cleft untuk penekanan klausul adverbial kontras.
complex.targetSentence: It was not until yesterday that the board ratified the agreement.
complex.explanation: It was not until yesterday + that the board ratified the agreement.
hints: Mulai dengan 'It was not until yesterday'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'that the board ratified the agreement'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki struktur Wh-cleft aksi yang berlebihan.
complex.draft: What the engineer did was he repaired the turbine unit.
options: What the engineer did was repair the turbine unit.
What did the engineer was he repaired the turbine unit.
It was what the engineer did he repaired the turbine unit.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'What the engineer did was...', tidak boleh ada subjek ganda 'he'. Cukup gunakan bare infinitive atau to-infinitive: 'was repair the turbine unit'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence exhibiting formal preparatory It-cleft focus on prepositional phrase:
options: It was under heavy pressure from shareholders that the chairman tendered his resignation.
It was the chairman under heavy pressure resigned.
Under pressure it was that the chairman resigns.
complex.explanation: It was + [prepositional phrase] + that + clause merupakan formula standar penekanan kondisi atau situasi dalam tulisan formal.

dialogue: Judge
Does the defense dispute the sequence of events?
Counsel
No, Your Honor. ___ the intent behind those actions.
complex.explanation: Wh-cleft penekanan poin perselisihan: 'What we vigorously dispute is the intent...'.

complex.prompt: Check verb agreement inside an It-cleft when highlighting 'I': 'It is I who ___ responsible for signing off on safety protocols.'
complex.explanation: Dalam ragam sangat formal, kata kerja di dalam klausa 'who...' menyesuaikan diri dengan antecedent-nya ('I' → 'am', bukan 'is'). (Dalam gaya netral modern, 'It's me who is...' lebih lazim.)

complex.prompt: Similarly, with a plural subject focus: 'It was our regional distributors, not the central warehouse, that ___ the new packaging labels.'
complex.explanation: Klausa 'It was' selalu tunggal di depan, lalu kata kerja setelah 'that' mengikuti subjek fokus sebenarnya ('our regional distributors' aktif 'requested').
hints: 'Our regional distributors' bertindak sebagai pelaku aktif masa lampau.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda 'The reason why ... is because' yang dianggap pleonasme dalam penulisan akademik berikut.
complex.draft: The main reason why coastal aquifers turned saline was because excessive pumping lowered groundwater pressure.
options: The main reason why coastal aquifers turned saline was that excessive pumping lowered groundwater pressure.
The main reason coastal aquifers turned saline was because excessive pumping lowered groundwater pressure.
Because coastal aquifers turned saline was that excessive pumping lowered groundwater pressure.
complex.explanation: Dalam tulisan akademik/IELTS formal, 'The reason ... is/was BECAUSE' adalah pengulangan makna sebab; ganti 'because' setelah 'was' menjadi 'that'.
hints: 'Reason' sudah bermakna sebab, jadi 'was because' mubazir.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang fungsi pragmatis cleft sentence.
dialogue: Professor
Both sentences give the same facts: 'Dr. Tan isolated the enzyme' vs 'It was Dr. Tan who isolated the enzyme.' When should a writer pick the cleft?
Student
A writer chooses the cleft structure specifically to ___ against an explicit or implied misconception.
options: highlight and contrast a single key element ('Dr. Tan', not someone else)
shorten word count in tight technical footnotes
avoid specifying who performed the experiment
complex.explanation: Fungsi retoris utama cleft sentence bukan menyingkat kalimat, melainkan memecah kalimat untuk memberi SOROTAN KONTRAS ('Dr. Tan, bukan peneliti lain') terhadap asumsi pembaca.
hints: Cleft sentence justru menambah kata demi penekanan fokus kontras.
Pilih fungsi penekanan dan kontras retoris.

complex.prompt: What happens when ___ fails during peak load is that requests automatically route to the Singapore mirror.
complex.explanation: Dalam Wh-cleft kompleks ('What happens when [S+V] is that...'), klausa 'when' tetap memakai urutan normal Subject + Verb tanpa inversi.
hints: Gunakan urutan normal tanpa auxiliary tanya.

complex.prompt: The place ___ those ancient kiln fragments were unearthed lies twelve kilometers inland.
complex.explanation: Place-cleft dengan 'The place...' tanpa preposisi ('in') memerlukan relative adverb 'where' (setara 'in which').
hints: Ada kata 'The place' diikuti klausa lengkap pasif tanpa 'in'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan konstruksi It-cleft saat menyoroti sebuah gerund phrase berikut.
complex.draft: It is by reading primary manuscripts carefully which scholars avoid misquoting historical sources.
options: It is by reading primary manuscripts carefully that scholars avoid misquoting historical sources.
It is by reading primary manuscripts carefully what scholars avoid misquoting historical sources.
It are by reading primary manuscripts carefully that scholars avoid misquoting historical sources.
complex.explanation: Saat It-cleft menonjolkan frasa adverbial cara ('by reading primary manuscripts carefully'), penghubungnya WAJIB 'that' (tidak boleh 'which' maupun 'what').
hints: Fokusnya adalah frasa preposisi 'by reading...', bukan kata benda.

complex.prompt: All I did ___ forward the encrypted PDF to the legal desk as instructed.
complex.explanation: Dalam all-cleft penekanan tindakan ('All I did was [to] V1'), kata kerja linking utamanya tetap 'was' diikuti bare infinitive 'forward'.
hints: Subjek 'All I did' menuntut linking verb 'was'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat It-cleft untuk menekankan klausa waktu dengan 'not until'.
complex.targetSentence: It was not until the final audit cleared that the bank released the escrow funds.
complex.explanation: Pola formal: 'It was not until [clause 1] that [clause 2]' (tanpa inversi setelah 'that').
hints: Awali dengan 'It was not until the final audit cleared'.
Tambahkan 'that the bank released the escrow funds'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat reason-cleft formal yang benar secara akademis (pakai 'was that').
complex.targetSentence: The primary reason why small startups stall is that they underestimate onboarding time.
complex.explanation: 'The primary reason why ... is that...' menghindari pleonasme 'is because'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The primary reason why small startups stall is'.
Sambungkan dengan 'that they underestimate onboarding time'.
